ChangeNotes.Value:
v3.0.0 - the big one. Much of it is freshly built, and this is a one-man hobby project: if something misbehaves, please report it in the comments and it will be mended.
ONE SCREEN FOR EVERYONE YOU KNOW * The chat and letter windows are a single screen now: everyone you know in one list - here, away, or gone - and the one you choose drawn there alive, the way the game draws a talk on the map. * Letters ride in the same thread as the spoken words, and the same box does both: Enter speaks, or the button becomes Seal and send. * They shift their stance as you talk, and inside a town the talk can move between the street, the tavern and the keep. * Both old keys (O and Y) open it; the old windows survive as a setting.
THE VOICES (off by default) * They can be heard: a play mark beside every line - replies, letters, their own quiet thoughts. * A handful of voices ship with the mod; clone your own for free on your own machine, or put in a key for hosted voices (billed by the minute, shown honestly). * Anyone you have not cast is given a voice of their own people and sex. Backspace silences everything, anywhere.
THE CHILDREN * Every child born to you is written down in two parts: the hour, in the mother's own voice, kept between the two of you - and the feast you choose, from bread and salt to a whole town rejoicing. * A child born outside marriage asks a heavier question: own it before the world, own it quietly, or say nothing. And every child keeps its own memory from the day it is born.
LIFE AFTER THE WEDDING * A courtship can fork: a woman whose heart has gone past what marriage asks may offer herself as your lover. Her father is paid for losing her, the world has a name for her place, and what she makes of it is her own. * A wife's door can be shut against you - with her reasons written in her own words, and nothing opens it but her own judgment. * Wives keep a reckoning of your nights, and word of another woman travels in proportion to what you spent on her.
THE COMPANY YOU KEEP * People come to you more, and it costs less: nobody weighs the visit in private any more - when the moment falls to someone, they simply cross the room and speak. * The cold runs one way: someone who has come to dislike you goes quiet instead of seeking you out. The one you are wed to comes to you far more readily than anyone else. * Couriers always outride you, and a letter still on the road is handed over the moment you meet its writer.
Plus a long tail of fixes - the conception odds are provably right now, the night clock keeps the sun, town journals no longer repeat their goods, scouts count the wounded and the bound, and more. Full record: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
Full model guide: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/docs/choosing-a-model.md
